12. jwt 生成 token 设置有效期，获取 claims 验证是否有效 ​

java
package com.me.util;

import javax.crypto.Mac;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * JWT Utility class for creating and validating JWT tokens
 * Implements JWT functionality without third-party dependencies
 */
public class JwtUtil {
    
    private static final String ALGORITHM = "HmacSHA256";
    private static final String DEFAULT_SECRET = "my-secret-key-for-jwt-signing-should-be-secure";
    
    /**
     * Create a JWT token with default expiration (24 hours = 86400 seconds)
     * @param claims Map of claims to include in the token
     * @return JWT token string
     */
    public static String createToken(Map<String, Object> claims) {
        return createToken(claims, 86400); // Default 24 hours in seconds
    }
    
    /**
     * Create a JWT token with custom expiration in seconds
     * @param claims Map of claims to include in the token
     * @param expireSeconds Number of seconds until token expires
     * @return JWT token string
     */
    public static String createToken(Map<String, Object> claims, int expireSeconds) {
        return createToken(claims, expireSeconds, DEFAULT_SECRET);
    }
    
    /**
     * Create a JWT token with custom expiration and secret
     * @param claims Map of claims to include in the token
     * @param expireSeconds Number of seconds until token expires
     * @param secret Secret key for signing
     * @return JWT token string
     */
    public static String createToken(Map<String, Object> claims, int expireSeconds, String secret) {
        // Add standard claims
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>(claims);
        long now = Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
        payload.put("iat", now); // Issued at
        payload.put("exp", now + expireSeconds); // Expiration time in seconds
        payload.put("jti", UUID.randomUUID().toString()); // JWT ID
        
        // Create header
        String header = "{\"alg\":\"HS256\",\"typ\":\"JWT\"}";
        String encodedHeader = base64UrlEncode(header.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        
        // Create payload
        String payloadJson = mapToJson(payload);
        String encodedPayload = base64UrlEncode(payloadJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        
        // Create signature
        String dataToSign = encodedHeader + "." + encodedPayload;
        String signature = hmacSha256(dataToSign, secret);
        String encodedSignature = base64UrlEncode(signature.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        
        // Combine all parts
        return encodedHeader + "." + encodedPayload + "." + encodedSignature;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate JWT token
     * @param token JWT token to validate
     * @return true if valid, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean validateToken(String token) {
        return validateToken(token, DEFAULT_SECRET);
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate JWT token with custom secret
     * @param token JWT token to validate
     * @param secret Secret key for verification
     * @return true if valid, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean validateToken(String token, String secret) {
        try {
            if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
                return false;
            }
            
            String[] parts = token.split("\\.");
            if (parts.length != 3) {
                return false;
            }
            
            String header = parts[0];
            String payload = parts[1];
            String signature = parts[2];
            
            // Verify signature
            String dataToSign = header + "." + payload;
            String expectedSignature = hmacSha256(dataToSign, secret);
            String encodedExpectedSignature = base64UrlEncode(expectedSignature.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            
            if (!signature.equals(encodedExpectedSignature)) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // Check expiration
            Map<String, Object> claims = getClaimsFromToken(token);
            Long exp = (Long) claims.get("exp");
            if (exp != null && Instant.now().getEpochSecond() > exp) {
                return false; // Token expired
            }
            
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Extract claims from JWT token
     * @param token JWT token
     * @return Map of claims
     */
    public static Map<String, Object> getClaimsFromToken(String token) {
        try {
            String[] parts = token.split("\\.");
            if (parts.length != 3) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid token format");
            }
            
            String payload = parts[1];
            byte[] decodedPayload = base64UrlDecode(payload);
            String payloadJson = new String(decodedPayload, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            
            return jsonToMap(payloadJson);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to extract claims from token", e);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if token is expired
     * @param token JWT token
     * @return true if expired, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isTokenExpired(String token) {
        try {
            Map<String, Object> claims = getClaimsFromToken(token);
            Long exp = (Long) claims.get("exp");
            return exp != null && Instant.now().getEpochSecond() > exp;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return true; // Treat invalid tokens as expired
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Get remaining time until token expires
     * @param token JWT token
     * @return Remaining seconds until expiration, negative if expired
     */
    public static long getRemainingTime(String token) {
        try {
            Map<String, Object> claims = getClaimsFromToken(token);
            Long exp = (Long) claims.get("exp");
            if (exp == null) {
                return -1; // No expiration set
            }
            return exp - Instant.now().getEpochSecond();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1; // Invalid token
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * HMAC SHA256 implementation
     */
    public static String hmacSha256(String data, String secret) {
        try {
            Mac mac = Mac.getInstance(ALGORITHM);
            SecretKeySpec secretKeySpec = new SecretKeySpec(
                secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), ALGORITHM);
            mac.init(secretKeySpec);
            byte[] hash = mac.doFinal(data.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(hash);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to generate HMAC", e);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Base64 URL encode (RFC 7515 compliant)
     */
    public static String base64UrlEncode(byte[] data) {
        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(data);
    }
    
    /**
     * Base64 URL decode (RFC 7515 compliant)
     */
    public static byte[] base64UrlDecode(String data) {
        return Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(data);
    }
    
    /**
     * Simple JSON to Map converter (basic implementation)
     */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static Map<String, Object> jsonToMap(String json) {
        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        // Remove braces
        String content = json.trim();
        if (content.startsWith("{") && content.endsWith("}")) {
            content = content.substring(1, content.length() - 1);
        }
        
        // Split by comma, but be careful with nested objects
        String[] pairs = content.split(",");
        for (String pair : pairs) {
            String[] keyValue = pair.split(":", 2);
            if (keyValue.length == 2) {
                String key = keyValue[0].trim().replaceAll("\"", "");
                String value = keyValue[1].trim();
                
                // Handle different value types
                if (value.startsWith("\"") && value.endsWith("\"")) {
                    // String value
                    result.put(key, value.substring(1, value.length() - 1));
                } else if (value.matches("-?\\d+")) {
                    // Integer
                    result.put(key, Long.parseLong(value));
                } else if (value.matches("-?\\d+\\.\\d+")) {
                    // Double
                    result.put(key, Double.parseDouble(value));
                } else if ("true".equals(value)) {
                    result.put(key, true);
                } else if ("false".equals(value)) {
                    result.put(key, false);
                } else if ("null".equals(value)) {
                    result.put(key, null);
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    /**
     * Simple Map to JSON converter (basic implementation)
     */
    private static String mapToJson(Map<String, Object> map) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("{");
        boolean first = true;
        
        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : map.entrySet()) {
            if (!first) {
                sb.append(",");
            }
            sb.append("\"").append(entry.getKey()).append("\":");
            
            Object value = entry.getValue();
            if (value instanceof String) {
                sb.append("\"").append(value).append("\"");
            } else {
                sb.append(value);
            }
            first = false;
        }
        sb.append("}");
        return sb.toString();
    }
    
    /**
     * Set custom secret key
     * @param secret New secret key
     */
    public static void setSecret(String secret) {
        // In a real application, you'd want to store this securely
        // This is a simplified implementation
        System.setProperty("jwt.secret", secret);
    }
    
    /**
     * Get current secret key
     * @return Current secret key
     */
    public static String getSecret() {
        return System.getProperty("jwt.secret", DEFAULT_SECRET);
    }
}

13. easyexcel 导出多级动态表头 ​

java
package com.me.util;

import com.alibaba.excel.EasyExcel;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BiFunction;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * EasyExcel 动态多级表头导出工具
 * <p>
 * 核心能力：
 * <ul>
 *   <li>多级表头（自动合并相邻相同单元格）</li>
 *   <li>动态列（按维度展开，如按月份展开"收入/奖金"列）</li>
 *   <li>行转列透视（多行数据 → 一行，维度值横向展开）</li>
 *   <li>缺失数据自动补 null</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <h3>示例 1：行转列透视（推荐，一行搞定）</h3>
 * <pre>{@code
 * DynamicExcelExporter.create()
 *     .path("output.xlsx")
 *     .sheet("销售报表")
 *     .pivot(
 *         saleList,
 *         SaleDO::getCode,                          // 行键（分组依据）
 *         Arrays.asList("编号", "姓名"),               // 固定列表头
 *         row -> Arrays.asList(row.getCode(), row.getName()),  // 固定列取值
 *         SaleDO::getMonth,                         // 维度提取
 *         (row, sub) -> "收入".equals(sub)
 *             ? row.getTotalIncome() : row.getTotalComm(),  // 动态列取值
 *         "收入", "奖金"                              // 子列名
 *     )
 *     .doWrite();
 * }</pre>
 *
 * <h3>示例 2：手动构造表头 + 数据（更灵活）</h3>
 * <pre>{@code
 * DynamicExcelExporter.create()
 *     .path("output.xlsx")
 *     .headLevelCount(2)
 *     .fixedColumn("姓名", "姓名")
 *     .dynamicColumn(months, "收入", "奖金")
 *     .data(dataList)       // 手动构造 List<List<Object>>
 *     .doWrite();
 * }</pre>
 *
 * <h3>示例 3：Web 下载（输出到 HttpServletResponse）</h3>
 * <pre>{@code
 * DynamicExcelExporter.create()
 *     .sheet("报表")
 *     .pivot(...)
 *     .doWrite(response.getOutputStream());
 * }</pre>
 */
public class DynamicExcelExporter {

    // ==================== 字段 ====================

    private final List<List<String>> headers = new ArrayList<>();
    private String filePath;
    private OutputStream outputStream;
    private String sheetName = "Sheet1";
    private int headLevelCount = 1;

    /** 动态列配置（用于构建表头 + 行转列） */
    private final List<DynamicColumnDef> dynamicColumns = new ArrayList<>();

    /** 手动设置的数据 */
    private List<List<Object>> manualData;

    /** 透视配置（pivot 模式） */
    private PivotConfig<?> pivotConfig;

    // ==================== 入口 ====================

    private DynamicExcelExporter() {}

    public static DynamicExcelExporter create() {
        return new DynamicExcelExporter();
    }

    // ==================== 基础配置 ====================

    /** 输出文件路径 */
    public DynamicExcelExporter path(String filePath) {
        this.filePath = filePath;
        this.outputStream = null;
        return this;
    }

    /** 输出到文件对象 */
    public DynamicExcelExporter file(File file) {
        return path(file.getAbsolutePath());
    }

    /** 输出到流（适合 Web 下载: response.getOutputStream()） */
    public DynamicExcelExporter stream(OutputStream out) {
        this.outputStream = out;
        this.filePath = null;
        return this;
    }

    /** Sheet 名称 */
    public DynamicExcelExporter sheet(String sheetName) {
        this.sheetName = sheetName;
        return this;
    }

    /**
     * 表头层级数（默认 1）。所有列的表头层级数必须一致。
     * 设为 2 时，固定列需传 2 个参数: {@code fixedColumn("编号", "编号")}
     */
    public DynamicExcelExporter headLevelCount(int count) {
        if (count < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("headLevelCount 必须 >= 1");
        this.headLevelCount = count;
        return this;
    }

    // ==================== 表头定义 ====================

    /**
     * 添加一列表头，层级数需与 {@link #headLevelCount} 一致。
     * EasyExcel 会自动合并相邻相同的文字。
     * <p>例: head("2024-01", "收入") → 2级表头
     */
    public DynamicExcelExporter head(String... levels) {
        if (levels.length != headLevelCount) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "表头层级数不匹配: 期望 " + headLevelCount + " 级, 实际 " + levels.length + " 级");
        }
        headers.add(Arrays.asList(levels));
        return this;
    }

    /**
     * 直接设置完整表头（手动模式）。跳过逐列构建，直接传入已构造好的表头列表。
     * 每个 List&lt;String&gt; 代表一列从上到下的表头文字。
     */
    public DynamicExcelExporter head(List<List<String>> headerList) {
        this.headers.clear();
        this.headers.addAll(headerList);
        if (!headerList.isEmpty()) {
            this.headLevelCount = headerList.get(0).size();
        }
        return this;
    }

    /**
     * 添加固定列（所有层级使用相同文字，自动合并）。
     * <p>例: fixedColumn("姓名")  在 2 级表头下 = head("姓名", "姓名")
     */
    public DynamicExcelExporter fixedColumn(String name) {
        String[] levels = new String[headLevelCount];
        Arrays.fill(levels, name);
        return head(levels);
    }

    /**
     * 添加固定列，自定义每一级的文字。
     * <p>例: fixedColumn("基本信息", "姓名")
     */
    public DynamicExcelExporter fixedColumn(String... levels) {
        return head(levels);
    }

    // ==================== 动态列（仅表头，手动填数据） ====================

    /**
     * 添加动态列：按维度展开，每个维度生成 subColumns 个列。
     * 此方法仅构建表头，数据需通过 {@link #data} 手动构造。
     * <p>
     * 例: dynamicColumn(["2024-01","2024-02"], "收入", "奖金")
     * → 4列: 2024-01/收入, 2024-01/奖金, 2024-02/收入, 2024-02/奖金
     */
    public DynamicExcelExporter dynamicColumn(List<String> dimensions, String... subColumns) {
        if (dimensions == null || dimensions.isEmpty() || subColumns.length == 0) return this;
        List<String> subList = Arrays.asList(subColumns);
        dynamicColumns.add(new DynamicColumnDef(dimensions, subList));
        buildDynamicHeaders(dimensions, subList);
        return this;
    }

    /**
     * 添加多组动态列，共享相同的维度列表。
     * 例: dynamicColumnGroups(months, ["收入","奖金"], ["支出","利润"])
     */
    @SafeVarargs
    public final DynamicExcelExporter dynamicColumnGroups(List<String> dimensions, List<String>... subGroups) {
        if (dimensions == null || dimensions.isEmpty()) return this;
        for (List<String> subs : subGroups) {
            dynamicColumns.add(new DynamicColumnDef(dimensions, subs));
            buildDynamicHeaders(dimensions, subs);
        }
        return this;
    }

    // ==================== 数据 ====================

    /** 直接设置数据行（每行列数必须与表头列数一致） */
    public DynamicExcelExporter data(List<List<Object>> data) {
        this.manualData = data;
        return this;
    }

    /** 追加一行数据 */
    public DynamicExcelExporter addRow(Object... values) {
        if (this.manualData == null) this.manualData = new ArrayList<>();
        this.manualData.add(Arrays.asList(values));
        return this;
    }

    // ==================== 行转列透视（推荐 API） ====================

    /**
     * 行转列透视：一行代码完成表头构建 + 数据转换。
     * <p>
     * 自动完成：
     * 1. 从数据中提取维度列表（去重，保持原序）
     * 2. 构建多级表头（固定列 + 动态列）
     * 3. 按行键分组，将多行数据透视为一行
     * 4. 缺失维度自动补 null
     *
     * @param data                原始数据（每条记录包含一个维度值）
     * @param rowKeyExtractor     行键提取（用于分组，如 SaleDO::getCode）
     * @param fixedHeaders        固定列表头
     * @param fixedValueExtractor 固定列取值函数（从一条记录中提取固定列值）
     * @param dimensionExtractor  维度提取（如 SaleDO::getMonth）
     * @param valueExtractor      动态列取值 (data, subColumnName) → value
     * @param subColumns          子列名（如 "收入", "奖金"）
     */
    public <D> DynamicExcelExporter pivot(
            List<D> data,
            Function<D, String> rowKeyExtractor,
            List<String> fixedHeaders,
            Function<D, List<Object>> fixedValueExtractor,
            Function<D, String> dimensionExtractor,
            BiFunction<D, String, Object> valueExtractor,
            String... subColumns) {

        return pivot(data, rowKeyExtractor, fixedHeaders, fixedValueExtractor,
                dimensionExtractor, null, valueExtractor, subColumns);
    }

    /**
     * 同上，支持显式指定维度列表（用于自定义维度顺序或补全缺失维度）。
     *
     * @param dimensionList       维度列表（为 null 时自动从数据提取）
     */
    public <D> DynamicExcelExporter pivot(
            List<D> data,
            Function<D, String> rowKeyExtractor,
            List<String> fixedHeaders,
            Function<D, List<Object>> fixedValueExtractor,
            Function<D, String> dimensionExtractor,
            List<String> dimensionList,
            BiFunction<D, String, Object> valueExtractor,
            String... subColumns) {

        if (data == null || data.isEmpty()) return this;
        if (subColumns.length == 0) return this;

        // 默认 2 级表头
        if (headLevelCount <= 1) headLevelCount(2);

        // 固定列表头
        for (String fh : fixedHeaders) {
            fixedColumn(fh);
        }

        // 维度列表（从数据提取或使用给定列表）
        List<String> dimensions = dimensionList != null ? dimensionList
                : data.stream()
                    .map(dimensionExtractor)
                    .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                    .distinct()
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // 动态列表头
        List<String> subList = Arrays.asList(subColumns);
        dynamicColumns.add(new DynamicColumnDef(dimensions, subList));
        buildDynamicHeaders(dimensions, subList);

        // 保存透视配置
        this.pivotConfig = new PivotConfig<>(data, rowKeyExtractor, fixedValueExtractor,
                dimensionExtractor, dimensions, valueExtractor, subList, fixedHeaders.size());

        return this;
    }

    // ==================== 执行导出 ====================

    /** 写入文件（使用之前 path() 设置的路径） */
    public void doWrite() {
        if (filePath == null && outputStream == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("未设置输出目标, 请调用 path() / file() / stream()");
        }
        writeInternal(filePath, outputStream);
    }

    /** 写入指定文件路径（覆盖之前的 path 设置） */
    public void doWrite(String filePath) {
        writeInternal(filePath, null);
    }

    /** 写入指定流（适合 Web 下载） */
    public void doWrite(OutputStream out) {
        writeInternal(null, out);
    }

    private void writeInternal(String path, OutputStream out) {
        List<List<Object>> finalData = resolveData();

        if (out != null) {
            EasyExcel.write(out).head(headers).sheet(sheetName).doWrite(finalData);
        } else {
            EasyExcel.write(path).head(headers).sheet(sheetName).doWrite(finalData);
        }
    }

    /** 解析最终数据：透视模式自动行转列，否则使用手动数据 */
    private List<List<Object>> resolveData() {
        if (pivotConfig != null) {
            return buildPivotData();
        }
        return manualData != null ? manualData : Collections.emptyList();
    }

    /** 执行行转列透视 */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private <D> List<List<Object>> buildPivotData() {
        PivotConfig<D> cfg = (PivotConfig<D>) pivotConfig;

        // 按行键分组（LinkedHashMap 保持顺序）
        Map<String, List<D>> groups = cfg.data.stream()
                .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(cfg.rowKeyExtractor, LinkedHashMap::new, Collectors.toList()));

        List<List<Object>> result = new ArrayList<>(groups.size());

        for (Map.Entry<String, List<D>> entry : groups.entrySet()) {
            List<D> group = entry.getValue();
            D first = group.get(0);

            // 维度 → 数据 的快速查找映射
            Map<String, D> dimMap = new HashMap<>(group.size());
            for (D item : group) {
                dimMap.put(cfg.dimensionExtractor.apply(item), item);
            }

            List<Object> row = new ArrayList<>();

            // --- 固定列 ---
            row.addAll(cfg.fixedValueExtractor.apply(first));

            // --- 动态列：维度 × 子列 ---
            for (String dim : cfg.dimensions) {
                D item = dimMap.get(dim);
                for (String sub : cfg.subColumns) {
                    if (item != null) {
                        row.add(cfg.valueExtractor.apply(item, sub));
                    } else {
                        row.add(null);  // 该人无该维度数据 → 留空
                    }
                }
            }

            result.add(row);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // ==================== 内部辅助 ====================

    private void buildDynamicHeaders(List<String> dimensions, List<String> subColumns) {
        for (String dim : dimensions) {
            for (String sub : subColumns) {
                if (headLevelCount == 1) {
                    headers.add(Collections.singletonList(dim + " " + sub));
                } else if (headLevelCount == 2) {
                    headers.add(Arrays.asList(dim, sub));
                } else {
                    // 3+ 级：顶层填维度，中间层同顶层（自动合并），底层填子列
                    String[] levels = new String[headLevelCount];
                    Arrays.fill(levels, dim);
                    levels[headLevelCount - 1] = sub;
                    headers.add(Arrays.asList(levels));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** 动态列定义 */
    private static class DynamicColumnDef {
        final List<String> dimensions;
        final List<String> subColumns;

        DynamicColumnDef(List<String> dimensions, List<String> subColumns) {
            this.dimensions = dimensions;
            this.subColumns = subColumns;
        }
    }

    /** 透视配置 */
    private static class PivotConfig<D> {
        final List<D> data;
        final Function<D, String> rowKeyExtractor;
        final Function<D, List<Object>> fixedValueExtractor;
        final Function<D, String> dimensionExtractor;
        final List<String> dimensions;
        final BiFunction<D, String, Object> valueExtractor;
        final List<String> subColumns;

        PivotConfig(List<D> data,
                     Function<D, String> rowKeyExtractor,
                     Function<D, List<Object>> fixedValueExtractor,
                     Function<D, String> dimensionExtractor,
                     List<String> dimensions,
                     BiFunction<D, String, Object> valueExtractor,
                     List<String> subColumns,
                     int fixedColCount) {
            this.data = data;
            this.rowKeyExtractor = rowKeyExtractor;
            this.fixedValueExtractor = fixedValueExtractor;
            this.dimensionExtractor = dimensionExtractor;
            this.dimensions = dimensions;
            this.valueExtractor = valueExtractor;
            this.subColumns = subColumns;
        }
    }
}
java
package com.me.service;

import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
import com.me.domain.SaleDO;
import com.me.domain.SaleDOExtend;
import com.me.mapper.SalMapper;
import com.me.util.DynamicExcelExporter;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.test.annotation.Rollback;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
@Rollback(false)
@DisplayName("动态表头导出测试")
public class SalMapperTest {

    @Autowired
    SalMapper salMapper;

    /**
     * 方式一：pivot 模式（推荐）—— 一行代码完成表头 + 数据 + 行转列
     */
    @Test
    public void testExportByPivot() {
        List<SaleDO> doList = salMapper.list();

        DynamicExcelExporter.create()
                .path("da2.xlsx")
                .sheet("报表")
                .pivot(
                        doList,
                        SaleDO::getCode,                                      // 按编号分组
                        Arrays.asList("编号", "姓名"),                           // 固定列表头
                        row -> Arrays.asList(row.getCode(), row.getName()),    // 固定列取值
                        SaleDO::getMonth,                                     // 维度：月份
                        (row, sub) -> "收入".equals(sub)
                                ? row.getTotalIncome() : row.getTotalComm(),  // 动态列取值
                        "收入", "奖金"                                         // 子列
                )
                .doWrite();
    }

    /**
     * 方式二：手动模式 —— 自己构造表头和数据，更灵活
     */
    @Test
    public void testExportManual() {
        List<SaleDO> doList = salMapper.list();

        // 提取月份列表
        List<String> months = doList.stream()
                .map(SaleDO::getMonth)
                .distinct()
                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toList());

        // 手动构造表头 + 数据
        List<List<String>> headList = Lists.newArrayList();
        headList.add(Lists.newArrayList("编号", "编号"));
        headList.add(Lists.newArrayList("姓名", "姓名"));
        for (String m : months) {
            headList.add(Lists.newArrayList(m, "收入"));
            headList.add(Lists.newArrayList(m, "奖金"));
        }

        // 手动构造数据
        List<List<Object>> dataList = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Map<String, List<SaleDO>> nameMap = doList.stream()
                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.groupingBy(
                        d -> d.getCode() + "_" + d.getName(),
                        java.util.LinkedHashMap::new,
                        java.util.stream.Collectors.toList()));

        for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, List<SaleDO>> entry : nameMap.entrySet()) {
            List<Object> row = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            SaleDO first = entry.getValue().get(0);
            row.add(first.getCode());
            row.add(first.getName());

            java.util.Map<String, SaleDO> monthMap = entry.getValue().stream()
                    .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toMap(SaleDO::getMonth, v -> v, (a, b) -> a));
            for (String m : months) {
                SaleDO s = monthMap.get(m);
                row.add(s != null ? s.getTotalIncome() : null);
                row.add(s != null ? s.getTotalComm() : null);
            }
            dataList.add(row);
        }

        DynamicExcelExporter.create()
                .path("da2_manual.xlsx")
                .sheet("报表")
                .headLevelCount(2)
                .head(headList)              // 直接传入已构建的表头
                .data(dataList)
                .doWrite();
    }

    /**
     * 方式三：指定维度顺序 + Web 流输出示例
     */
    @Test
    public void testExportWithDimensionList() {
        List<SaleDO> doList = salMapper.list();

        // 显式指定月份顺序
        List<String> monthOrder = Arrays.asList("2024-01", "2024-02", "2024-03",
                "2024-04", "2024-05", "2024-06");

        DynamicExcelExporter.create()
                .path("da2_ordered.xlsx")
                .sheet("报表")
                .pivot(
                        doList,
                        SaleDO::getCode,
                        Arrays.asList("编号", "姓名"),
                        row -> Arrays.asList(row.getCode(), row.getName()),
                        SaleDO::getMonth,
                        monthOrder,   // 显式维度列表（不在数据中的月份会留空）
                        (row, sub) -> "收入".equals(sub)
                                ? row.getTotalIncome() : row.getTotalComm(),
                        "收入", "奖金"
                )
                .doWrite();
    }

    /**
     * 方式四：动态列 + Web 流输出示例
     */
    @Test
    public void testExportWithDynamicColumns() {
        List<SaleDOExtend> doList = salMapper.list2();
        DynamicExcelExporter.create()
                .path("da23.xlsx")
                .sheet("报表")
                .pivot(
                        doList,
                        SaleDOExtend::getName,                                      // 按编号分组
                        Arrays.asList("姓名"),                           // 固定列表头
                        row -> Arrays.asList(row.getName()),    // 固定列取值
                        SaleDO::getMonth,                                     // 维度：月份
                        (row, sub) -> "收入".equals(sub)
                                ? row.getTotalIncome() : "奖金".equals( sub)? row.getTotalComm() : row.getSubSal(),  // 动态列取值
                        "收入", "奖金" ,"罚款"                                        // 子列
                )
                .doWrite();
    }
